description: Find Cambridge, AQA or Edexcel past papers on exam.now from a free-text query such as "0580 june 2024 paper 4" or from structured fields. Returns up to 10 papers with their exam.now paper_id, title, session, duration, total marks, whether exam.now can show it on screen to answer (answer_on_screen, with the parts that need a graph or drawing and so can only be answered there), and links to the question paper, insert, mark scheme and examiner report where they exist. Use the paper_id with get_question, get_mark_scheme or get_paper.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "0625 w23 42" or "igcse physics november 2023 paper 4".

subject_code.description: Syllabus or specification code, e.g. 0580, 0625, 9709, 8300 or 1MA1.

name: find_past_paper
title: Find a past paper
